services.name: Maui Whale Watching Tour
services.desc: Seasonal humpback whale–watching cruise aboard the No Ka Oi departing from Kihei Boat Ramp.

services.name: 3-Hour Turtle Tour w/Photos
services.desc: Snorkel Maui’s Turtle Town, explore lava reefs, and search for Hawaiian green sea turtles on a relaxed three-hour adventure from Kihei.

services.name: 2 Hour Molokini Snorkel at Sunrise
services.desc: Snorkel Molokini at sunrise with calmer seas, fewer crowds, vibrant marine life, and unforgettable Haleakalā views—all in two hours.

services.name: 5-Hour Molokini & Turtle Tour
services.desc: Experience sunrise at Molokini, snorkel two iconic Maui reefs, and enjoy a refreshing shoreside comfort stop on our award-winning five-hour adventure.

services.name: Afternoon Private Whale Watch
services.desc: Private afternoon whale-watch charter around Maui’s south shore for up to 20 guests with expert narration and reef-safe sunscreen.
